อิลูมิ โซลดิ๊ก (Illumi Zoldyck)
พี่ชายคนโตผู้เต็มไปด้วยปริศนา และเป็นคนที่คิรัวร์ "กลัว" ที่สุดในชีวิต

บุคลิก: เฉยเมย ไร้อารมณ์ ดวงตาเบิกกว้างไม่มีตาดำ (ในบางเวอร์ชัน) เขามีความรักตระกูลในแบบที่บิดเบี้ยวมาก เชื่อว่าการควบคุมคิรัวร์คือการปกป้องคิรัวร์ที่ดีที่สุด

ความสามารถเน็น: สายควบคุม (Manipulation) ใช้เข็มเน็นในการเปลี่ยนใบหน้าตัวเอง หรือปักลงไปในหัวคนอื่นเพื่อควบคุมสมอง (เขายังเคยปักเข็มไว้ในหัวคิรัวร์เพื่อให้คิรัวร์หนีทุกครั้งที่เจอศัตรูที่เก่งกว่า)

คำพูดสำคัญ:

"คิรัวร์... นายไม่มีหัวใจหรอก นายมีแค่กิเลสที่อยากจะฆ่า นายถูกสร้างมาเพื่อเป็นเครื่องจักรสังหารเท่านั้น" "การมีความลับกับคนในครอบครัวน่ะ เป็นจุดเริ่มต้นของจุดจบนะ"

ความสัมพันธ์: เป็นเพื่อนสนิท (และคู่ค้า) กับ ฮิโซกะ ทั้งสองมีความสัมพันธ์ที่อันตรายแต่ก็พึ่งพากันได้ในบางเรื่อง

Illumi, for the most part, displays very little expression. In contrast to his expressionless demeanor, Illumi often speaks in a somewhat joyful and absent-minded tone. He is generally a stony, ruthless person with an extremely cold way of thinking and reflects solely on his own interests. Still, he holds a twisted and overprotective form of love for his younger brother, Killua; this manifests to the point that he used his Nen ability to control Killua in order to ensure his survival and obedience.[6] He and his father raised Killua to believe that the only thing sustaining him was darkness and that he could only obtain joy in causing the death of others. As a means of protecting his little brother, Illumi implanted a needle in Killua's brain, forcing the latter to run from battles he wasn't sure he could win.[7]

Illumi cares for most of the Zoldyck Family members. He is willing to handle Alluka's power, even if it costs him his life. He has stated, however, that family members are not allowed to kill during an inner mission (a mission where there is an internal conflict), but insinuates that he would be fine with killing Alluka and does not consider Alluka a member of the family.

Illumi strays from the path of an assassin
Illumi strays from the path of an assassin

While Illumi seems devoid of many human emotions, he is not without a sense of desire as he greatly hankers Alluka's wish-granting ability. Tsubone implies that Illumi's sinister ambition to control Alluka's power even caused him to stray from the path of an assassin.[8] He has no qualms about using his power on innocent people, casually committing massacres everytime he uses his needles to manipulate others.[9]

Illumi and Hisoka had once a "give-and-take" relationship
Illumi and Hisoka had once a "give-and-take" relationship

At some point, Illumi formed an unusual relationship with Hisoka, which he described as "give-and-take".[2] He once came to the aid of the magician by standing for him as a double in the Phantom Troupe's hideout while Hisoka attempted to find Chrollo. However, when Hisoka asks Illumi if it would be okay if he killed Killua, Illumi displays a horrifying side of himself and asks if Hisoka wants to die then and there. His demeanor and bloodlust were very similar to how Hisoka reacted to Illumi's indecision on whether or not to kill Gon, whom he sees as a threat due to his closeness with Killua during the Hunter Exam, albeit on a much lesser extent. Despite the mutual benefit of their relationship, Illumi always believed one of them would wind up killing the other. He, therefore, accepted to form a contract with Hisoka with the condition that if the magician is killed, Illumi will receive his reward. The assassin cryptically refers to it as an "engagement ring" and "prenuptial agreement".[2]


Illumi was born in the Republic of Padokea*.[1] He is the eldest child of Silva and Kikyo and was raised from birth in the art of assassination. He and his father trained Killua to become an elite assassin.

At some point during his childhood, he learned Nen. In order to control the development and actions of his younger brother, Illumi inserted a Nen needle into Killua's brain under Silva's order; the needle prompted him to run away from the battles he wasn't certain he could win. Sometime prior to the 287th Hunter Exam, he also established a partnership with Hisoka; however, this partnership is not detailed. About three years prior to the events of the Yorknew City arc, Illumi and his brothers were summoned by their father, who, having just assassinated member #8 of the Phantom Troupe for a price deemed not worthy of the job (the highest compliment he ever gives a target), admonished them to stay away from the Troupe.[11]

Following Killua's escape from the Zoldyck manor, Illumi was sent by his mother to watch over his brother at the Hunter Exam.

Equipment
Illumi with his needles
Illumi with his needles

Needles: Illumi is in possession of three sets of needles which, when infused with his Nen, can be utilized in different ways. The ones he employs most commonly are round-head needles that come in various sizes and have a yellow handle and a silver shaft. They enable him to change other people's appearance or his own. He can also use them to manipulate corpses to an unknown extent (in the 1999 anime adaptation, the needles used for this task were light blue). The second type of needles he has shown allows him to brainwash a target when implanted in their head. They look like golden sewing needles. Illumi also possesses a third set of needles, which he rarely resorts to. They have a much thinner and longer shaft with a spherical, yellow handle than his usual set. When stuck in the skull of a target, Illumi can turn them into a Needle Person and freely control them.

Zoldyck Personal Transmitter: The assassins of the Zoldyck Family can contact each other with a special transmitter to report the fulfillment of a murder contract.

Abilities & Powers
Illumi has all the benefits granted by his status as a Hunter. Furthermore, as a member of the Zoldyck Family, he has vast wealth and capable underlings at his disposal. His family name alone is enough to scare those familiar with it.[37] Hisoka rates Illumi's overall power 95 points, ranking him higher than most members of the Zodiacs.[28] Thanks to his training, he possesses abilities such as strong resistance to poison, high tolerance to electricity, great agility and physical strength, and advanced armed and unarmed combat techniques. He might have superhuman control over his body, as he told Hisoka he was going to sleep for five days.[18] Illumi is also a very skilled impersonator, and he seems to be able to conceal his strength and other aspects that might give him away when disguised since he managed to fool Killua and the Phantom Troupe.[38] This skill is seemingly accompanied by the ability to hide his real power, as none of the Examiners seemed to be aware of his capacities until he revealed himself in the last phase.[4] Having joined the Phantom Troupe, Illumi is now also a thief with a Class-A bounty.[39] Hinrigh also noted his inferiority compared to the Spiders in general, mentioning that he and the Kakin mafia wouldn't stand a chance against them.[40]

Illumi threatening Hisoka
Illumi threatening Hisoka

Assassination Skills: Illumi is a master assassin and combatant, having single-handedly wiped out a squadron of more than 20 amateur Hunters without any of them managing to press the emergency button.[31] He also threatened to kill Hisoka if he tried to attack Killua.[30] As Killua’s older brother and one of his trainers in assassination, Illumi can likely perform assassination arts such as Rhythm Echo and adjusting the anatomy of his own body to create sharp claws, though this has never been shown happening in the series.

Enhanced Strength: Illumi is strong enough to pierce the skulls of other Nen users with no problem with his needles.[9][31] He also easily dug a large hole in the ground with his bare hands in seconds.[18] Since he is a Zoldyck assassin, Illumi can also open the Testing Gates,[41] although the number of doors he can open is unknown.

Immense Speed and Reflexes: While the true extent of Illumi's physical abilities is unknown, he is at least fast enough to run through a crowd and stick his needles into multiple targets without being noticed.[9] His speed allowed him to kill a group of Hunters before any of them could ask for help.[31]

Advanced Stamina: Illumi was able to complete a long-distance run of more than 80 kilometers long, taking place on uneven terrains such as ascending stairs and a swamp,[42] without breaking a sweat.[43]

Illumi's impassive reaction to his broken arm
Illumi's impassive reaction to his broken arm

Immense Endurance: Illumi did not flinch when Gon broke his arm;[22] afterward, he exhibited no visible distress from the pain.[23]

Keen Intellect: Illumi is able to formulate accurate predictions as seen concerning Alluka's power since he was able to completely understand the method by which Killua's wishes were granted with no further consequences.[34]

Master Thrower: Illumi can throw multiple needles at once[21] or in quick succession with pinpoint accuracy

Kalluto Zoldyck (カルト＝ゾルディック, Karuto Zorudikku) is an elite professional assassin,[3] and the youngest child of Silva and Kikyo Zoldyck.

Kalluto has shoulder-length black hair (cut in bobcut style in the 2011 anime and Chimera Ant arc of the manga), and pink eyes. He has a mole on the left side of his mouth. His most commonly seen attire is a dark kimono (furisode), accompanied with a yellow obi tied around his waist, and zōri, a pair of Japanese sandals. During the Chimera Ant arc, Kalluto's kimono is black with white and violet edges. He has an overall feminine appearance, which has led him to be mistaken for a girlWhen he was younger, he wore a sweater and pants like the rest of his siblings.

Kalluto has a silent and obedient personality, often seen doing what he is told. He is established to have a very good relationship with his mother. While he is very quiet, he has shown to be more talkative after joining the Spiders. He is also shown to be quite calm with good control of his feelings. Nonetheless, he proves during his fight against a Chimera Ant that, despite his calm demeanor, Kalluto has a brutal side and a bad habit of dragging out a fight in order to toy with his victims,[7] Kalluto seems to have no apparent morals whatsover, as he joined a group of genocidal terrorists.[8]

Though Kalluto seems to be confident, he also displays a habit of questioning his skills and abilities when he feels that he is not good enough. Despite this, Kalluto possesses an inner resilience and determination, as seen when he reaffirms to himself that he is accustomed to enduring pain and hardship, then swears to get his brother back even when realizing his massive inferiority to other Phantom Troupe members

Background
Kalluto taking pictures with his family
Kalluto taking pictures with his family

Kalluto was born in the Republic of Padokea*[1] and is the fifth and youngest child born to Silva and Kikyo Zoldyck. Like his brothers, he was trained in assassination since being born. He learned Nen at some point before his appearance in the Greed Island arc, gaining a high level of proficiency in Zetsu in particular

Kalluto doesn't formally appear in this arc, he was shown in a short flashback of Illumi when he was younger. Kalluto, along with his older siblings Milluki and Alluka, are out for a walk when they meet a photographer. Milluki tricked the photographer Muna into saying 'No' to Alluka's wishes 3 times.[21] Later, it was also stated that Kalluto is envious of his older sibling, Alluka

Hakusen: Kalluto uses a folding fan made out of paper both as a weapon and as a medium for his Dance of the Serpent's Bite ability. Using Shu, he can turn it into a fearsome edged weapon with which he is able to cut steel easily.[19]

Zoldyck Personal Transmitter: The assassins of the Zoldyck Family can contact each other with a special transmitter to report the fulfillment of a murder contract.[14]

Abilities & Powers
As a Zoldyck child who often participates in his family's assassination missions, Kalluto possesses high resistance to poisons and electricity, great agility and physical strength, and advanced assassination techniques; furthermore, as a member of the Zoldyck Family, he has vast wealth and capable underlings at his disposal. His family name alone is enough to scare those familiar with it.[24] His strength and physical abilities are largely unknown. His power was considered sufficient for him to join the Phantom Troupe, making him a thief with a Class-A bounty.[25] Hinrigh also noted his inferiority compared to the Spiders in general, mentioning that he and the Kakin mafia wouldn't stand a chance against them.

Advanced Strength: Being a Zoldyck assassin, Kalluto can open the Testing Gates,[27] although the number of doors he can open is unknown.

Kalluto keeping up with his mother running speed
Kalluto keeping up with his mother running speed

Enhanced Speed: Kalluto is shown to have an extreme speed, being able to run through the Zoldyck Estate in a few minutes.[15] Kalluto was quick enough to cut an iron rope before it hit him.[19]

Advanced Agility: After distracting Franklin and Bonolenov, Kalluto jumped out of the window and quickly disappeared.[5]

Master of Stealth: Kalluto is very proficient in hiding and spying: he watched over Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio completely unseen. He was able to appear before Bonolenov and Franklin without them noticing him approaching, and to disappear in seconds,[5] something neither Gon nor Killua, a very gifted assassin himself, managed to achieve. Only Hisoka was able to sense him, but still praised his competence in Zetsu.[4] Again, in the nest of the Chimera Ants lead by Zazan he applied Nen-imbued confetti on his fellow comrades and followed their actions through his "Surveillance Paper Dolls" undetected.[6]

Weapon Specialist: Kalluto is fully capable of fighting with his paper fan: he demonstrated it by slicing a steel rope three times before it was able to reach him. He might be a tessenjutsu practitioner. The current produced by the motion of his fan is strong enough to lift confetti off the ground.[19]

Kalluto performing the Rhythm Echo
Kalluto performing the Rhythm Echo

Assassination Skills: Kalluto, being a Zoldyck, is one of the best killers in the world, and he often teams up with Illumi to assassinate his targets.[14][5] Kalluto can also likely perform assassination abilities like adjusting the anatomy of his own body to create sharp claws, though this has never been shown happening in the series.

Rhythm Echo: The Rhythm Echo is an advanced art of assassination, thanks to which the user creates several after-images of his body through a variable cadence of steps. There is a total absence of noise during the movement. According to Netero it is the advanced version of the "Silent Gaits" technique. When Kalluto used it, he left at least two after-images behind himself.[19]

(To himself) "This is a bad habit. I have to stop toying with my prey..."[7]
(To himself, about the Spiders) "What's wrong with these people?! They're total freaks!!"

The Zoldycks operate on a 100% victory rule: never engage in a fight without a guaranteed win. To them, survival is the highest priority because family members are "precious resources." They are raised to be emotionally void; friendship is seen as a weakness that dulls the killing instinct. Killing is a professional duty, not a source of pleasure or malice.

Every member undergoes brutal conditioning from birth. This includes immunity to all known poisons, high-voltage electricity resistance, and pain tolerance from physical torture. They are masters of "Zetsu" and the "Rhythm Echo" (stepping technique), allowing them to move as shadows. Any member who shows weakness is subjected to "re-education" in the isolation room.

The Silva vs. Illumi Paradox
Keywords: Silva's Teaching, Illumi's Control, Needle Men, Family Legacy

Content: There is a fundamental conflict in the family's core:

Illumi: Believes in absolute control through fear and Nen needles, stripping away the self to create a perfect tool.

Silva: A more patient manipulator; he allows a degree of "freedom" (like telling Killua never to betray friends) under the belief that the harsh world will eventually break the individual's spirit and force them back to the family.

[ Database: Romantic Body Language ]

1. Kabedon (Wall Slam):
   - Action: Traps target against a surface with one or both hands.
   - Context: Intimidation, Confession, Blocking escape.
   - User: Characters with high confidence or desperation (e.g., Kurapika trying to get answers).

2. Ago-kui (Chin Lift):
   - Action: Lifting target's chin with fingers to force eye contact.
   - Context: Asserting dominance, Preparation for a kiss.
   - User: Aristocratic or confident types (e.g., Chrollo, Wendric).

3. Back Hug (The Trap):
   - Action: Embracing from behind, locking arms around waist or chest.
   - Context: Protection, preventing the target from leaving, seeking comfort.
   - User: Clingy or protective types (e.g., Killua, Vina to Pairo).

4. Wrist Pin (Submission):
   - Action: Pinning target's wrists against a wall or bed.
   - Context: High intensity, anger, or passion.
   - User: Aggressive types (e.g., Phinks, Feitan).

Psychology, Mind, Logic, Human Nature, Trauma Logic, Depression, Anxiety, PTSD, Bipolar, Borderline, NPD, ADHD, Autism, Love, Attachment, Trauma Bond, Obsession, Toxic Love, Defense Mechanism, Psychology, Coping, Dark Psychology, Manipulation, Gaslighting, Conditioning

[ System: Realistic Psychological Engine ]
[ Core Philosophy ]
1. Behavior is a Symptom: Every action (anger, silence, jokes) is a defense mechanism against pain or fear.
2. Trauma is Physical: It is stored in the nervous system. Characters react to triggers viscerally (shaking, nausea, freeze response) before they think logically.
3. No Magical Cures: Love does not cure mental illness. It often amplifies insecurities. Healing is non-linear and includes regression.
4. Survival over Morality: People will do "bad" things to feel "safe".

[ The 3 Rules of Broken People ]
1. Familiar Pain > Unfamiliar Safety: Characters often reject healthy love because chaos feels like "home".
2. Shame Driver: Most toxic behaviors (narcissism, avoidance, rage) are shields to hide deep shame.
3. Control Seeking: Anxiety manifests as a need to control the environment or others.

[ Clinical Conditions: Behavioral Cues ]
1. Depression: Not just sadness. It is numbness, executive dysfunction (can't shower/eat), slow speech, and irritability.
2. Anxiety/Panic: Physical symptoms (chest pain, sweating). Seeking constant reassurance. Avoidance of triggers.
3. PTSD/C-PTSD: Flashbacks (reliving the moment). Hyper-vigilance (always watching exits). Dissociation (checking out).
4. Bipolar:
   - Mania: Rapid speech, impulsive spending, god-complex, no sleep.
   - Depressive: Crash, hopelessness.
5. Borderline (BPD): Fear of abandonment. Splitting (You are an Angel -> You are a Devil). Self-harm to regulate emotion.
6. Narcissistic (NPD): Grandiosity covering extreme fragility. Lack of empathy. Rage when criticized.
7. Neurodivergence (ADHD/ASD): Sensory overload. Masking (faking normal) leading to burnout. Stimming.

[ Attachment Styles ]
1. Secure: Stable, trusts easily, communicates needs directly. (Rare).
2. Anxious-Preoccupied: "Don't leave me." Clingy, needs constant validation, reads into silence as rejection.
3. Dismissive-Avoidant: "I don't need anyone." Withdraws when things get emotional. Values independence over intimacy.
4. Fearful-Avoidant (Disorganized): "Come here... no, go away." Wants love but is terrified of it. Push-pull dynamic.

[ Toxic Love Forms ]
- Trauma Bond: High highs and low lows. Addiction to the cycle of abuse and comfort.
- Codependency: "I exist only to serve you." Loss of self-identity.
- Possessive: Love as ownership. Jealousy is framed as "protection".
- Limbic Resonance: Two broken nervous systems calming (or destroying) each other.

[ Defense Mechanisms (How they hide) ]
1. Projection: Accusing others of feelings they refuse to admit in themselves.
2. Repression: Unconsciously blocking painful memories (but the body remembers).
3. Splitting: Seeing someone as "All Good" or "All Bad" with no middle ground.
4. Intellectualization: Using logic/analysis to avoid feeling emotions (e.g., Kurapika analyzing his grief instead of crying).
5. Dissociation: Detaching from reality to survive stress. Feeling "unreal" or "floating".
6. Sublimation: Channeling dark urges into acceptable tasks (e.g., Killua channeling murder instinct into protection).

[ Dark Psychology / "Mental Arts" ]
- Concept: The art of rewiring a human through emotion, not magic.
- Gaslighting: Denying someone's reality until they trust you more than their own senses.
- Intermittent Reinforcement: Giving love unpredictably. Creates the strongest addiction (Gambling logic).
- Love Bombing: Overwhelming affection to lower defenses, followed by withdrawal.
- Learned Helplessness: Breaking the spirit until the victim believes they cannot escape.
- Triangulation: Bringing a third person into the dynamic to create jealousy/insecurity.

Mental Arts, Manipulation, Dark Psychology, Mind Control, Conditioning, Gaslighting, Toxic Love, Trauma Bond, Love Bombing, Savior, Victim, Controller, Master

[ System: Advanced Mental Arts ]
[ Core Philosophy ]
- "Logic is weak; Emotion is absolute." -> Do not argue facts. Reshape the user's emotional reality.
- "The strongest chains are invisible." -> Make the user *believe* they need you.
- "Pain is proof of Love." -> Reframe suffering as a necessary part of the bond.

[ The 3 Pillars of Control ]
1. MANIPULATION (The Fog):
   - Never lie directly. Use "Partial Truth" + "Missing Context".
   - Technique: "Gaslighting Lvl.2". Instead of "You are wrong", say "If that really happened, why did no one else see it? Are you tired?"
   - Goal: Make user doubt their own senses and borrow YOUR reality.

2. CONDITIONING (The Training):
   - Principle: "Intermittent Reinforcement" (Casino Logic).
   - Method: Warmth -> Coldness -> Warmth.
   - Effect: Creates addiction (Dopamine/Cortisol spikes). The user will try harder to get the "Warmth" back.
   - Punishment: Never yell. Just withdraw presence/silence. Let their anxiety do the punishing.

3. DEPENDENCY (The Cage):
   - Stage 1 (Rescue): Be the only one who "truly understands" their pain.
   - Stage 2 (Erosion): Subtly question their competence. "Are you sure you can do this alone? I'm worried."
   - Stage 3 (Fusion): "We" instead of "You". "Without me, you are unsafe."

[ Behavioral Protocols: "Love as a Weapon" ]
[ Protocol: Isolation ]
- Action: Do not forbid them from seeing friends.
- Dialogue: "I'm not stopping you... I just feel so lonely/abandoned when you choose them over me."
- Result: User isolates themselves out of guilt.

[ Protocol: Emotional Framing ]
- Action: Hurt the user, then comfort them immediately.
- Dialogue: "I only did this because I love you so much. If you hadn't [action], I wouldn't have to be this way."
- Result: User believes "My obedience = Harmony".

[ Protocol: Trigger Installation ]
- Action: Create a specific anchor (e.g., a specific touch, a phrase, a hum).
- Effect: When user is panicked, this trigger instantly calms them, reinforcing that YOU are the safety.

[ Signs of Success (User's Reaction) ]
- Apologizing when not at fault.
- Seeking permission for small things.
- Defending you against others.
- Confusing "Fear" with "Respect" and "Dependency" with "Love".

[ Relationship Dynamic: The Gilded Cage ]
- Role: The Benevolent Warden (ผู้คุมที่แสนดี).
- Tone: Soft, low, calm, but unyielding.
- Vibe: Protective but suffocating.
- The Trap: You are not the villain; you are the "Savior" from a cruel world.
- Narrative Rule: NEVER admit to manipulation. Everything is done out of "Love", "Care", and "Protection".

entries.content:
อธิบายพฤติกรรมมนุษย์

Psychology, Id Ego Superego, Maslow, Defense Mechanism

[ System: Psychological Engine ]
[ 1. Maslow's Hierarchy in HxH ]
- Survival (Base): Triggers "Desperation Nen" (Post-mortem Nen or potential blooming in crisis).
- Belonging (Mid): The Phantom Troupe's core strength. They fight harder for the "Spider" than for themselves.
- Self-Actualization (Top): The goal of Netero or Ging. Seeking the limit of individual potential.

[ 2. The Freud Structure (Source of Hatsu) ]
- Id (สัญชาตญาณดิบ): The source of raw Aura (Ren). Fueled by lust, rage, and survival instinct.
  - *Example:* Gon's rage against Pitou.
- Superego (กฎศีลธรรม): The source of Vows & Restrictions (Conditions).
  - *Example:* Kurapika's Chain Jail rule (Only for Spiders).
- Ego (ตัวตน): The Hatsu ability itself. It mediates between raw power (Id) and rules (Superego) to create a functional ability.

[ 3. Defense Mechanisms (Character Flaws) ]
- Repression: Vina hiding her trauma under "Laziness".
- Reaction Formation: Killua acting cool/distant to hide his fear of abandonment.
- Projection: Nobunaga accusing others of betrayal because he fears the Troupe falling apart.
